question: Which genres have the most movies?

graph.sql:
SELECT g.name AS genre_name, COUNT(*) AS movie_count
FROM public.m_genre mg
JOIN public.genre g ON mg.gid = g.gid
GROUP BY g.name
ORDER BY movie_count DESC;

preserve.sql:
SELECT g.name, COUNT(mg.mid) AS movie_count
FROM public.m_genre mg
JOIN public.genre g ON mg.gid = g.gid
GROUP BY g.name
ORDER BY movie_count DESC;

question: Show the top 5 directors by number of movies directed.

graph.sql:
SELECT p.name, COUNT(*) AS num_movies
FROM public.m_director md
JOIN public.person p ON md.pid = p.pid
GROUP BY p.pid, p.name
ORDER BY num_movies DESC
LIMIT 5;

preserve.sql:
SELECT p.name, COUNT(*) AS num_movies
FROM public.m_director d
JOIN public.person p ON d.pid = p.pid
GROUP BY p.pid, p.name
ORDER BY num_movies DESC
LIMIT 5;

question: Which actor-director pairs have collaborated the most?

graph.sql:
SELECT p_actor.name AS actor_name, p_director.name AS director_name, COUNT(DISTINCT mc.mid) AS collaboration_count
FROM public.m_cast mc
JOIN public.m_director md ON mc.mid = md.mid
JOIN public.person p_actor ON mc.pid = p_actor.pid
JOIN public.person p_director ON md.pid = p_director.pid
GROUP BY p_actor.name, p_director.name
ORDER BY collaboration_count DESC
LIMIT 10;

preserve.sql:
SELECT 
    p_actor.name AS actor_name,
    p_director.name AS director_name,
    COUNT(*) AS collaboration_count
FROM public.m_cast c
JOIN public.m_director d ON c.mid = d.mid
JOIN public.person p_actor ON c.pid = p_actor.pid
JOIN public.person p_director ON d.pid = p_director.pid
GROUP BY p_actor.name, p_director.name
ORDER BY collaboration_count DESC
LIMIT 10;
